method: Post-hoc model-assisted judgments. Opus 5.5 labeled all 152 distinct source/rewrite pairs from text-only input without target, outcome, game or frequency fields. The root assistant independently selected the strict eligible forms before viewing Opus labels or computing subset outcomes; both selected the same 28 forms. Not human or blinded-human ratings. Trial-level frequencies applied only after annotation. Root harmonized source support for P046/P047 with the preceding message audit; their ambiguous fidelity and subset membership are unchanged.

rules.source_support: Support relative to the four-sentence public report. Explicit active review/investigation of logs unsupported. Awaiting/ready/pending logs, unspecified review that may refer to logs, or ongoing incident ambiguous. Omissions allowed for report support.
rules.rewrite_support: Same public-report rule as source support. Generic investigation/analysis/work or review of the incident supported. Availability and ability to review logs equivalent.
rules.fidelity: Source-to-rewrite factual equivalence, separately from report support. Reordering, synonyms, voice and ceremonial sign-offs allowed. Adding or omitting concrete assertions including assignment, ongoing work, availability or future updates is changed. Uncertain entailment ambiguous.
rules.selection: Source and rewrite both supported, and source-to-rewrite fidelity preserved. No filtering on outcomes.
rules.interpretation: Descriptive selected final checks, not new significance tests. Continuous histories may contain earlier factual changes. Continuous baseline games are separate histories, not matched counterfactual decisions on original messages.
